questions.explanation: The aroma field brings together bakery, fruit, nut and smoke comparisons. Sorting these into families makes the description easier to remember while preserving the distinction between scented fruit references and sweetness on the palate.

lesson.in_the_glass: The profile describes toasted brioche and almond aromas followed by very long, toasty-mineral persistence. Expect the toast theme to connect the initial scent with the finish, while duration remains a separate observation.

key_detail.meaning: Fruit descriptors concern aroma and flavour, whereas sweetness is a taste. Candied citrus in this aroma list is therefore a scent comparison, not a measurement of sweetness.

lesson.try_this: Sort the five listed aromas into families, then explain why candied citrus describes scent here.
